//: RESEARCH-ONLY config. Never used for live trading, never referenced by the live bot process (see user_data/config.json for that). This file exists solely so `freqtrade download-data` / `freqtrade backtesting` (and hermes backtest, which wraps them) have a historical-data source that isn't the live exchange -- see RAILWAY.md for why. Live trading stays on Hyperliquid regardless of what this file says.

exchange.//: binanceusdm as a DATA SOURCE only -- research backtests never place orders (dry_run is always true above, and hermes backtest never runs `freqtrade trade`). Same pairs as the live Hyperliquid config, since StatArbSwing.Y_PAIR/X_PAIR are hardcoded to these two -- this file changes where the candles come from, not what the strategy trades. No API key/secret needed: public OHLCV endpoints don't require authentication.
exchange.name: binanceusdm
